mobile.setup.owner_missing: Run lop login-status; restore the owning login. Setup will not repoint an existing tunnel or pending request.
mobile.setup.owner_mismatch: Select the existing tunnel's owning credential; setup never switches accounts.
mobile.setup.stopped: Remote access was deliberately stopped. Use lop tunnel start only when you intend to resume it.
mobile.setup.invalid_response: Radient returned an invalid setup response; retry later.
mobile.setup.balance: Add credit yourself at https://console.radienthq.com/dashboard/tunnels; setup never purchases credit. Then retry.
mobile.setup.choose_login: Choose the intended account from lop login-status, then run lop tunnel setup --credential-id <id>.
mobile.setup.login: Run lop login radient to sign in to the owning account, then retry.
mobile.setup.account_failed: Fresh Radient account/route verification failed. Check connectivity and lop login-status; no setup writes were made.
mobile.setup.complete: Open the URL above and sign in with the same Radient account. Use lop tunnel stop to turn off remote access.
mobile.setup.cloudflared: Install cloudflared 2025.4.0 or newer using your package manager (macOS: brew install cloudflared), then rerun lop tunnel setup. An agent may run the installation with normal tool approval.
mobile.setup.price_unavailable: The current monthly price is unavailable; retry later.
mobile.setup.reserved: Cloud tunnel reservation saved on this device.
mobile.setup.verification: The connection is not yet confirmed. Run lop tunnel setup --json to check the cloud route, connector, and protected phone interface.
mobile.setup.failed: Setup did not finish. Check lop tunnel setup --json, then retry with the current account/quote. Completed steps have not been undone.
mobile.setup.activated: Existing tunnel activation saved; owning credential unchanged.
mobile.setup.usage: Use /mobile status or enable [monthly price] [--credential-id <id>], billing, start, stop.
mobile.setup.checking: Checking the owning account, local prerequisites and mobile route…
mobile.setup.billing_activated: Billing activation completed at the accepted monthly price.
mobile.setup.identity_unavailable: identity unavailable — check your signed-in accounts
mobile.setup.mobile_bundle: Prepare the phone interface first with lop mobile install (normal tool approval), then retry setup. No setup changes were made.
mobile.setup.mobile_bundle_tui: Ask your agent to prepare the phone interface with an approved lop mobile install, then run /mobile enable again. No setup changes were made.
mobile.setup.supervisor_tui: Background setup is unavailable on this computer. Ask your agent to prepare a supported user service or run the connector in a terminal, then check /mobile status. No setup changes were made.
mobile.setup.consent: Activating sets up this Radient account’s tunnel subscription at USD {amount}/month, reserves your phone address, and installs/starts the background connector. It does not purchase credit.
mobile.setup.quote_changed: The current price is USD {current}/month, not the USD {accepted} you accepted. Your submitted amount was not accepted; check the current quote before trying again.
mobile.setup.failed_tui: Setup did not finish. Check /mobile status, then retry with {command}. Completed steps have not been undone.
mobile.setup.login_tui: Sign in with /login radient, then run /mobile status.
mobile.setup.verification_tui: The connection is not yet confirmed. Check /mobile status; completed setup steps remain saved.
mobile.setup.complete_tui: Open the URL above and sign in with the same Radient account. Use /mobile stop to turn off remote access.
mobile.setup.applying: Preparing phone access — checking the account and local prerequisites before making changes…
mobile.setup.activating: Applying — activating this account’s tunnel subscription at the accepted price…
mobile.setup.configuring: Applying — enabling the existing route without changing its owner…
mobile.setup.installing: Applying — preparing and starting the background connector…
mobile.setup.verifying: Checking the connection — waiting for the cloud route, connector and protected phone interface…
mobile.setup.billing_not_activated: Billing: the current subscription still needs activation.
mobile.setup.billing_already_active: Billing: the subscription was already active.
mobile.setup.billing_activated_status: Billing: subscription activation completed; this has not been undone.
mobile.setup.billing_unconfirmed: Billing: activation was requested but its outcome is unconfirmed. Check the account before retrying; do not assume rollback.
mobile.setup.reservation_saved: Phone address: reservation saved on this computer; retry reuses it.
mobile.setup.reservation_unconfirmed: Phone address: reservation outcome unconfirmed; retry uses the saved request key.
mobile.setup.cloudflared_tui: Ask your agent to install cloudflared 2025.4.0 or newer through the supported package manager with normal approval, then run /mobile enable again.
mobile.setup.title_login: Phone access needs a Radient sign-in
mobile.setup.title_owner_choice: Phone access needs an account choice
mobile.setup.title_owner_missing: Phone access needs its original account
mobile.setup.title_quote_changed: Phone access needs a new price confirmation
mobile.setup.title_cloudflared: Phone access needs the connector tool
mobile.setup.title_mobile_bundle: Phone access needs the phone interface
mobile.setup.title_supervisor: Phone access needs a background service
mobile.setup.title_account: Phone access could not check your account
mobile.setup.title_apply: Phone access is ready to set up
mobile.setup.title_verification: Phone access is waiting for a connection
mobile.setup.title_failed: Phone access could not finish setup
mobile.setup.title_stopped: Phone access is deliberately turned off
mobile.setup.unexpected_failure: Phone access could not finish. Check /mobile status for the current blocker; completed steps have not been undone.
mobile.setup.in_progress: Phone access setup is already in progress; check its status before retrying.
mobile.setup.quote_unread: Check the fresh account and quote before enabling phone access.
mobile.setup.corrupt_intent: The saved phone setup request is invalid. Leave create.json unchanged and ask your agent to recover the original request before retrying. No setup changes were made.
